# Vyana

> Vyana is a longitudinal health memory layer for patients in India. Upload your records once and never explain your medical history again — Vyana keeps a unified timeline, vitals trends, medications, and a doctor-ready briefing always at hand.

Vyana is a consumer health app (patients only). It turns scattered prescriptions, lab reports, discharge summaries, and imaging into a single, searchable health story. The hero of the product is the AI-generated clinical briefing patients carry into every doctor visit. Vyana provides clinical decision support and discussion points only — it is not a diagnosis engine and does not replace medical advice.
